title: Thermal commissioning
requirement: Verify redundant supervisors, temperature sensors, pump current and both coolant loops

title: Thermal endurance
requirement: Maintain simulated 15–65 C under heat pulse and loop failover; preserve survival heating

title: Fault recovery
requirement: Repair Q1, R1 and TH1 faults; rerun independent tests

title: Safety requalification
requirement: W465 open inhibits nonessential actuators; reconnect, verify and explicitly reset
